messages:
Oncall Bot: Pager: High error rate on model-serve pool eu-west-1 (p95 latency > 2s, 15% 5xx) — impacted customers: cust-regen, analytics-pro. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-serving-backpressure.md :rotating_light:
Devon: saw it. I'm in GMT+1, but heading offline in ~30m for family dinner. can someone take primary when I step out? :wave:
Aj: I can cover the bridge for the next hour, then I have a meeting. Not sure about deep dive but can hold the pager and follow runbook.
Maria: I can shadow and keep an eye on customer threads. I'm in PST so available for a few hours.
Priya: on vacation but pinged me — I can be reachable for escalations if needed.
Devon: thanks. quick triage: looks like backlog on the encoder workers causing kv cache thrash. runbook step 1 = scale workers, step 2 = drain unhealthy nodes, step 3 = fallback to smaller model variant.
Devon: copying commands from runbook:
```bash
# scale encoder pool quickly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/encoder-worker --replicas=10
# check queue depth
kubectl -n inference exec -it svc/queue-metrics -- curl /metrics | grep request_queue_depth
```
Aj: running scale now. patching HPA to avoid oscillation.
Ops Bot: Deploy job started: scale encoder-worker -> 10 replicas (initiated by Aj) :gear:
Maria: Nate (CS) — can you update cust-regen slack/zoom? they might be watching.
Nate (CS): doing a quick note to both customers. telling them we're on it and may have brief degraded latency while we scale.
Devon: if scaling doesn't reduce 5xx in 5 min, we should flip traffic to the compatible v2-small model variant. That'll reduce quality slightly but keeps SLAs. runbook has the fallback toggle.
Aj: scaled to 10, queue depth dropping from 1200 -> 320 in the last 90s. 5xx still ~8% but trending down.
SRE Lead: good call on fallback as next knob. Also set an alert for rollout side-effects (rejects). Priya, if you see any odd infra alarms, escalate to me.
Maria: while Aj holds primary, I'll be secondary for customer comms and will keep the status message updated.
Devon: assigning primary/secondary for the handoff: Aj -> primary (until 1754013000), Maria -> secondary (customer comms). After 1754013000 I need a volunteer to be primary for the remaining 40m of my shift. I won't be reachable during that dinner window.
Aj: confirmed primary until 1754013000. I'll stay on bridge. adding a short note to thread when I hand off.
Maria: will keep status: "Scaling encoder pool; latency improving; possible fallback to v2-small if errors persist."
Oncall Bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1754012345 — invited: @Devon @Aj @Maria @Priya @SRE Lead
Devon: if fallback needed, steps:
1) set model-route override: `redwoodctl route set --model v2-small --target cust-regen,analytics-pro --ttl 300`
2) monitor per-customer error/latency dashboards
3) if stable, plan gradual rollback after peak (usually 2h)
This is in runbook under "fallback-to-compatible-variant".
Aj: I'm seeing per-cust latency for analytics-pro drop after scale, cust-regen still has sporadic 5xx. deploying fallback to cust-regen only as canary? Thoughts?
SRE Lead: canary to single customer is safer. Maria/Nate coordinate message to cust-regen saying we may flip them to v2-small for stability, brief quality downgrade, but service continuity.
Nate (CS): will post now. pinging their support slack and account lead.
Maria: posted and linked bridge. they acknowledged and prefer continuity, ok to flip canary.
Aj: executing canary flip for cust-regen now.
Ops Bot: Route change applied for cust-regen -> v2-small (initiated by Aj). Monitoring.
Aj: canary looks stable so far (3 min). 5xx for cust-regen dropped to near 0, overall p95 improved.
Devon: excellent. I'm going to step out now. Aj, once you hand off, please tag the new primary and include a quick one-liner status.
Aj: stepping up as primary. Will stay until 1754013000. Maria -> please be ready to take primary if I need to drop.
Maria: ready. I'll take primary if you drop.
Devon: thank you all. key runbook pointers embedded above. Final note: update incident doc post-incident with root cause hypothesis (encoder memory leak + traffic spike) and cost impact for Dedicated pools.
Maria: will start a postmortem doc skeleton and include customer comms timeline.
SRE Lead: good. capture the exact replica counts and timestamps for scaling and route changes. Also include lessons: HPA thresholds need tuning for weekend traffic patterns.
Aj: handoff: primary -> Aj (1754012345 -> 1754013000). status: scaled encoders, canary fallback applied for cust-regen, overall metrics improving. handing to whoever is online at 1754013000. :white_check_mark:
Maria: ack. I'll be on standby and will take primary if needed after 1754013000.
Priya: reachable for escalations if things spike again. enjoy dinner Devon :v: 
Devon: back offline. Thanks everyone. :pray:
